data_note: SYNTHETIC daily log returns (mean 0, vol 1.4%), seed=99 -- not real market data

kupiec_pof_test.conclusion: Fail to reject H0: observed breach rate 0.0533 is not statistically distinguishable from the expected 0.0500 at the 5% level.
kupiec_pof_test.sample_size_caveat: n_obs=150 is below the ~250-observation (roughly one trading year) rule of thumb for reasonable test power; failing to reject the null here is weak evidence, not proof of a correct model.
